retrieval_note: Every request for the PDF (and for https://kalshi.com/fee-schedule) on 2026-11-25 returned HTTP 429 with a 'Vercel Security Checkpoint' JavaScript challenge page instead of the document; a web-fetch tool got the same 429. An earlier attempt on 2026-11-24 hit the same checkpoint. No example was taken from the schedule itself. The challenge was not circumvented.
formula: fee = round_up_to_cent(rate x multiplier x contracts x price x (1 - price)); taker rate 0.07; maker rate 0.0175 for quadratic_with_maker_fees, 0.035 for quadratic_with_combo_maker_fees, 0 for quadratic. Formula as recorded in docs/spec.md ('Facts checked on 2026-11-24', schedule effective 2026-07-07); maker rates per fee type from the FeeType description in the exchange's OpenAPI document.
hand_computed_note: Cases labelled 'hand-computed' were worked out by hand with exact fractions from the formula above, not copied from the schedule. They pin the formula and the rounding, not the exchange's published numbers.

examples.label: exchange-docs
examples.note: The 'FCM-cleared fill' worked example states a buy with -$0.055000 signed revenue and a model fee of $0.00363825. With multiplier 1 that is uniquely 1 contract at $0.055 (0.07 x 1 x 0.055 x 0.945). Only the model fee is stated there; the exchange then rounds the balance change, not the fee, so the cent-rounded fee below is this module's conservative estimate, not a number from that page.
